name: IRTDUpdateEvent
remarks: To instantiate or return an IRTDUpdateEvent object, declare a variable as an IRTDUpdateEvent object, and then use that variable as a callback object.

properties.name: HeartbeatInterval
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long for the interval between updates for real-time data. Read/write.

methods.name: UpdateNotify
methods.description: The real-time data (RTD) server uses this method to notify Microsoft Excel that new data has been received.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Instructs the real-time data (RTD) server to disconnect from the specified IRTDUpdateEvent object.
